culprit_citations.quoted_text: Interest Rate Type schedule totals 100.00% of investments at fair value for December 31, 2025.
First Lien(3)(4) - Undrawn row has Reference, Spread, and Interest Rate all shown as \u2014 in the source.

findings.detail: The dl_rate_fill warning is driven by counting undrawn/unfunded commitments whose source Reference, Spread, and Interest Rate cells are intentionally blank/dash, not by missing extractable stated rates.

rationale: The flag reports only 65.4% row-count fill (144 missing of 416), but the raw SOI has an explicit Interest Rate column and the 2025 Interest Rate Type schedule sums to 100.00% of investments at fair value. Representative missing-rate rows are undrawn commitments where the filer prints dashes for Reference, Spread, and Interest Rate. These source-intended blanks should not be treated as extractable direct-lending rate failures, so the check is over-scoped rather than exposing a data error.
